answer_1.quote: Generative model with abilities to produce detailed analyses of responses before rendering a judgment is widely used for LLM-as-a-judge. Instruct LLM to generate Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning to analyze each step of the response preforms outstandingly in judge tasks... Additionally, we assess our model on chat benchmarks such as AlignBench and MT-Bench.
answer_1.outputs: Generated judgments with CoT analyses for evaluation tasks and responses for dialogue generation.

answer_2.quote: Our 32B-model achieves SOTA performance... We adopt the leading pair-wise judge benchmark, RewardBench to evaluate the performance of our model... Additionally, we assess our model on chat benchmarks such as AlignBench and MT-Bench.
